core: Pathogen subversion of host epithelial cells
qualifier: cell-cell junctions and actin-dependent bacterial entry
name: Pathogen exploitation of host cell junctions and actin
rationale: Members cover SARS-CoV targeting of junctional PDZ proteins and host signalling plus bacterial attachment, actin-driven motility and Listeria InlA entry into epithelia, which separates it from confusables centred on viral protein maturation or Mtb phagosome manipulation.

name: Centrosome maturation at mitotic entry
rationale: All members describe recruitment or loss of centrosomal proteins (NuMA, Nlp, TPX2-activated AURKA) as centrosomes mature for mitosis, unlike confusables about centrosome positioning, microtubule nucleation or spindle/PLK1 control.

qualifier: methylmalonyl-CoA mutase step and its defects
name: Propionyl-CoA catabolism via methylmalonyl-CoA mutase and defects
rationale: Members are propionyl-CoA breakdown and the MUT, MMAA and MMAB defects causing methylmalonic acidemia, distinguishing it from cobalamin uptake/processing and branched-chain amino acid catabolism confusables.

qualifier: purine and pyrimidine de novo synthesis, deoxynucleotides and pyrimidine turnover
name: Purine and pyrimidine nucleotide biosynthesis and turnover
rationale: Members span de novo purine and pyrimidine synthesis, deoxyribonucleotide production, pyrimidine salvage and catabolism and nucleotide interconversion, whereas confusables focus on purine salvage, nucleoside triphosphate catabolism, drug ADME or nucleoside transport.

name: FGFR signalling via FRS/SHC adaptors to MAPK
rationale: Members are FGFR ligand binding, FRS- and SHC-mediated cascades to MAPK and their regulators (Sprouty, FGFRL1), separating it from the PI3K and PLC-gamma FGFR branches and generic RAS/MAPK feedback confusables.

qualifier: MTF1 and metallothionein response to essential metals
name: Metallothionein and MTF1 response to essential metal ions
rationale: Members are responses to zinc, copper, manganese and iron with MTF1-driven metallothionein induction, distinguished from confusables about cadmium/mercury detoxification, metal transporters or ROS detoxification.

qualifier: metabolic response to activity and disuse
name: Skeletal muscle metabolic adaptation to activity and disuse
rationale: Members cover muscle activity/inactivity responses, atrophy, fiber-type switching, PGC-1alpha activation, glucocorticoid response and energy-metabolic regulation, unlike confusables on calcineurin-driven hypertrophy, cardiac adaptation or muscle growth.

name: AP-1 immediate-early gene transcriptional response
rationale: Members are AP-1 activation and network, NR4A-enriched growth-factor-induced genes and TNF/NF-kB-induced early response, distinguished from confusables on PI3K/UV/p38 signalling, upstream JNK/TAK1 kinases or mRNA decay.

core: Selenium metabolism and thyroid hormone action
name: Selenium metabolism, selenocysteine incorporation and thyroid hormone activity
rationale: Members combine dietary selenium metabolism, selenocysteine synthesis and readthrough insertion with thyroid hormone transport, activation and signalling, which confusables on iodide/sulfate transport, PAPS or peroxide metabolism lack.

name: Progestin, androgen and estrogen biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover pregnenolone and progesterone synthesis, androgen and estrogen synthesis, aromatase deficiency and the adrenodoxin electron supply, separating it from glucocorticoid/mineralocorticoid biosynthesis confusables.

name: Ascorbate and antioxidant micronutrient defence against oxidative stress
rationale: Members link vitamin C metabolism and transport, vitamin E and selenium responses with ROS detoxification and redox homeostasis, distinct from confusables on iron, BH4/NO, thyroid peroxide or NADPH/aldehyde detoxification.

core: Early neural plate and hindbrain patterning
name: Hox-driven hindbrain and neural plate patterning
rationale: Members are neural plate formation and border specification, hindbrain rhombomere and boundary development, axis specification and the Hox clusters, the Hox content separating it from neural/axial mesoderm and craniofacial confusables and the neural content from the somitogenesis confusable.

qualifier: ubiquitinated receptor downregulation and exosome biogenesis
name: ESCRT multivesicular body sorting of ubiquitinated receptors and exosomes
rationale: Members cover ESCRT and MVB biogenesis, ubiquitin-dependent endocytosis, EGFR/MET downregulation and exosome release, distinguished from ESCRT confusables on HIV budding and nuclear envelope sealing and from autophagy confusables.

name: Receptor internalization and degradation controlling LDL cholesterol uptake
rationale: Members concern cargo recognition, receptor internalization, recycling and lysosomal degradation, especially LDLR/VLDLR, together with sterol homeostasis, unlike confusables on caveolar endocytosis, SREBP control or chylomicron/VLDL lipolysis.

qualifier: ribosome quality control and stress granule dynamics
name: Proteasomal degradation with ribosome quality control and stress granules
rationale: Members are regulation of proteasomal and degron-based degradation, ribosome-associated quality control of stalled nascent chains and stress granule assembly/disassembly, which ERAD, ubiquitin-linkage and PKR/PML confusables lack.

core: Response to reactive gases and peroxide
name: Response to gasotransmitters, peroxide and ischemia
rationale: Members are responses to nitric oxide, reactive nitrogen species, hydrogen sulfide, hydrogen peroxide, oxygen and ischemia, distinguished from confusables on ferroptosis, peroxide-induced apoptosis or ROS detoxification.

qualifier: lymphocyte and dendritic cell homing to lymphoid organs
name: Lymphocyte and dendritic cell chemotaxis and lymphoid organ homing
rationale: Members cover B and T cell and myeloid DC chemotaxis, lymphocyte homing and migration into lymphoid organs and marginal zone B cell positioning, versus confusables on general chemokine/CXCR4 signalling or S1P-driven lymph node development.

name: Aggresome formation, aggrephagy and stress granule dynamics
rationale: All members concern aggresome assembly and aggrephagy or stress granule assembly and disassembly, distinguished from confusables on ribosome quality control, ERAD/misfolded protein response or chaperone-mediated autophagy.

name: p53 activation and pro-apoptotic target gene transcription
rationale: Members cover regulation of TP53 levels and cofactors and TP53 transcription of death receptors, caspases and cytochrome c release genes, unlike confusables on p21-mediated arrest or negative regulation and PUMA translocation.

name: Mitochondrial protein import through outer membrane into matrix
rationale: Members are mitochondrial protein import, matrix import and outer membrane organization, distinguished from confusables on respiratory complex assembly, mitochondrial proteolysis/processing or cristae formation.

name: Zinc, copper and manganese transport and homeostasis
rationale: Members cover SLC39/SLC30 zinc transport, copper import and detoxification, ceruloplasmin defect and manganese transport, separating it from cadmium detoxification and iron/ferroportin confusables.

name: Carnitine-dependent fatty acid import for beta-oxidation
rationale: Members are the carnitine shuttle, carnitine transport and its SLC22A5 defect and promotion of beta-oxidation, distinguished from malonyl-CoA/negative regulation, monocarboxylate transport and ketone body confusables.

name: Hair follicle and tooth ectodermal appendage development
rationale: Members span hair follicle placode formation, odontoblast/odontogenesis and cementum mineralization and ectodermal differentiation, combining tooth and hair content each confusable lacks in part, and lacking their epidermis, gland or EDA-ID content.

qualifier: including inner ear and vestibulocochlear development
name: Craniofacial and inner, middle, outer ear morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover neurocranium, viscerocranium, face and nose development with cochlea, semicircular canal, otic vesicle, middle and outer ear and vestibulocochlear nerve formation, distinguishing it from gland-organ and cranial nerve/olfactory confusables.

qualifier: negative control of cGAS-STING and IFN signalling
name: Negative regulation of cGAS-STING and type I interferon signalling
rationale: Members are negative regulation of cGAS/STING, IFN-beta production and IFNA/IFNB signalling, TREX1 and IFN-beta response, distinguished from confusables centred on IRF3-mediated induction and RIG-I/MDA5 regulation.
